plan: A little keeper who knocks her enemies into walls and sends them flying with her hammer.
aSurveiller: Her E (Heroic Charge). She knocks you back and stuns you if you hit a wall: don't fight near walls.
contrer: Stay away from walls: her E stuns you there.
Don't dash at her: her W blocks dashes around her.
Interrupt her charged R: otherwise it sends you very far.
forces: Her R ejects an enemy from the fight.
faiblesses: Low damage in the late game.

sorts.P: Throws her buckler; picking it up grants a shield.
sorts.Q: Hammer strike that slows then explodes.
sorts.E: Charge that knocks back and stuns against a wall.
sorts.R: Strike that sends enemies very far.

momentFort.voie: Weaker early. She evens out at level 5, then becomes very strong in the mid game when her Q is maxed (level 9).
momentFort.jungle: Ganks from level 3 by pinning against walls. Level 6 isn't a big spike for her.
